definitions.gloss: to produce, to create, to generate
definitions.explanation: To bring something new into existence through effort or creativity. Used for ideas, works, products, profits, or results.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦アイデア→アイデア：10161_aidea⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{生|う}み{出|だ}す。
examples.english: To come up with a new idea.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{工場|こうじょう}→工場：01082_koujou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{製品|せいひん}→製品：01445_seihin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{生|う}み{出|だ}して⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: This factory produces many products every day.

examples.japanese: ⟦{努力|どりょく}→努力：03490_doryoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{素晴|すば}らしい→素晴らしい：01119_subarashii⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{生|う}み{出|だ}した。

notes:
{生|う}み{出|だ}す combines ⟦{生|う}む→生む：29531_umu⟧ (to give birth, to produce) and ⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧ (to put out).

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: Transitive (⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧)
- Takes ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ particle: 〜⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{生|う}み{出|だ}す

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦アイデア→アイデア：10161_aidea⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{生|う}み{出|だ}す: to generate ideas
- ⟦{利益|りえき}→利益：03673_rieki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{生|う}み{出|だ}す: to generate profit
- ⟦{価値|かち}→価値：00131_kachi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{生|う}み{出|だ}す: to create value
- ⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{生|う}み{出|だ}す: to produce works

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {生|う}み{出|だ}す: to create, produce (emphasizes bringing something new into being)
- ⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧: to make (general, broader use)
- ⟦{創造|そうぞう}する→創造する：29393_souzousuru⟧: to create (formal, emphasizes originality)
